description: This file defines an abstract class RestSerializer responsible for serializing HTTP requests for AWS services using REST protocol. It handles request construction, payload serialization, header and query parameter application, and URL building based on operation input definitions.

classes.name: RestSerializer
classes.description: An abstract class providing REST HTTP request serialization logic for AWS SDK operations, including request URI assembly, headers, query parameters, and payload handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with service API description and endpoint URL.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes a command into an HTTP request, resolving endpoint and applying input parameters.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method to serialize a payload member into the request options.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes operation input into request options including headers, query parameters, and payload.

methods.name: applyPayload
methods.description: Serializes payload member based on its type (streaming, string, blob).

methods.name: applyHeader
methods.description: Applies a header value to the request, formatting timestamps, booleans, and JSON values as needed.

methods.name: applyHeaderMap
methods.description: Applies a map of headers to the request.

methods.name: applyQuery
methods.description: Serializes query string parameters, handling booleans, timestamps, and maps.

methods.name: buildEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs the request URI based on operation, input arguments, and endpoint URL.

methods.name: hasPayloadParam
methods.description: Determines if operation input has a payload parameter that should be serialized.

methods.name: appendQuery
methods.description: Appends query parameters to a URI string.

methods.name: getVarDefinitions
methods.description: Builds a map of variables used for URI expansion from command input.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Ensures the endpoint path ends with a slash for proper URI resolution.
